action_items: A11y: add <DialogTitle> (and optional <DialogDescription>) to gallery-zoom, propose-dialog and apply-dialog to silence Radix console errors and support screen readers.
Optional: consider removing test data created during testing (see seed_data_creation).
critical_code_review_comments: schools_routes.decorate() is invoked per document in a loop (list_schools returns page_size docs, recommended_schools iterates full collection) and issues 2 separate count_documents queries per school (offers_count + followers_count). For scale (>50 schools) this is N+1; consider a $lookup aggregation or batched $group.
recommended_schools() and recommended_jobs() iterate to_list(200)/(300) without pagination and score in Python — fine now, but plan for aggregation-based ranking as data grows.

PUT /schools/me regenerates slug from name on every save even when name hasn't changed (unique_slug is called unconditionally). If a school renames back-and-forth it may accumulate '-2', '-3' suffixes and break shared/bookmarked public URLs. Consider keeping the existing slug when name is unchanged.

PUT /schools/me updates job_offers.school_name/school_slug via update_many — good — but does NOT rewrite applications.school_slug/school_name snapshots (already stored on POST /applications). Candidates may see outdated names. Acceptable if snapshot is intentional; document it.
public_contact() returns email/phone if visibility='public' regardless of whether the school is verified. Consider gating public contact behind is_verified to reduce spam scraping.
GET /schools/slug/{slug} increments views on every non-owner request with no debouncing — same viewer refreshing inflates numbers; consider a per-IP or per-user daily cap.
